Hi, I build practical AI/LLM applications and clean developer experiences. I enjoy shipping fast, iterating with users, and crafting simple UIs that make complex systems feel effortless.

Recently, I built a Multimodal PDF RAG Chatbot that extracts both text and images from PDFs, uses a vision model to describe visuals, stores everything in ChromaDB, and answers questions via a local LLM (Ollama) with a Streamlit UI. See the project post on the homepage for details.
